source_proof: All eight scheduled sweep calls use UIMPKernel; sweep order, partitions and stripe counter are unchanged.
At kn=1, all three old P chains equal bim*(1/aim). At every later kn they each equal bim/(aim-cim*P[kn-1]), with the same aim,bim,cim locals. Induction makes all three P chains identical.
P is initialized at kn=1 before its first read at kn=2. Q remains separate for U,V,W.
First lower half-cell friction, first upper half-cell friction, upper boundary k+1 values, relaxv arithmetic, locks, array-pool returns and copying are unchanged.
P arrays are local to each kernel call; no new shared state or cross-step cache is introduced.

Use alternating baseline/patch process order, warmup, same steps per pair and root-owned exclusive timing lock.
